image:image.image:caption: The rest of the sign-up form: email, mobile number, date of birth, password and a Public, Private or Business account.

image:image.image:caption: The Home feed: stories at the top, topic chips (Fun & Humor, Gaming, Music) and photo posts from people you follow.

image:image.image:caption: A post with like, comment, share and save, a caption and the next post coming up.

image:image.image:title: NOOB Socials – Home on a computer
image:image.image:caption: On a computer: a side menu on the left, the feed in the middle and NOOB members on the right.

image:image.image:title: NOOB Socials – Stories
image:image.image:caption: Stories last 24 hours. Reply to a story or send a heart.

image:image.image:caption: Reels: short vertical videos with sound, likes, comments, sharing, the song and a Follow button.

image:image.image:title: NOOB Socials – Explore
image:image.image:caption: Explore: search people and posts, filter by topic and browse a grid of pictures.

image:image.image:title: NOOB Socials – Create
image:image.image:caption: The Create button: make a Post, Reel, Story, Video, Live or Thought.

image:image.image:caption: Making a new post: pick photos or a video, or use the camera, then edit and share.

image:image.image:title: NOOB Socials – Chats
image:image.image:caption: Chats: the Global Lounge, private chats and groups, with unread counts and filters.

image:image.image:title: NOOB Socials – A chat
image:image.image:caption: A private chat with replies, reactions, voice and video calls.

image:image.image:title: NOOB Socials – Mini-games
image:image.image:caption: The noob arena: more than 50 mini-games, such as Ludo, with leaderboards.

image:image.image:title: NOOB Socials – Music Hub
image:image.image:caption: Music Hub: play songs, search by artist or genre and share songs in posts and chats.

image:image.image:title: NOOB Socials – Profile
image:image.image:caption: A profile: posts, followers and following, a bio, mood status and an Ask Me Anything link.

image:image.image:title: NOOB Socials – Profile posts
image:image.image:caption: The posts grid on a profile, with tabs for reels, videos and saved posts.
